The '''''Ku'Amo''''' was a modified [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] that was owned by the [[Shistavanen/Legends|Shistavanen]] [[Blik (Shistavanen)|Blik]].

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Blik flew the ''Ku'Amo'' to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Caarimon]], where he had been hired by the [[Believers]] to help then in a plot to release a deadly virus there. Blik brought with him the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[I4-M9]], which he kept deactivated, so that it would fit aboard the ''Ku'Amo''. He landed the Headhunter on the planet before heading out to work with the Believers. While it was there, a group of Caarite children played some games around the ship. A short time later, Blik took off it the ''Ku'Amo'' and became involved in a dogfight with another [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] above the planet.

The ''Ku'Amo'' was painted black, with gold trim.

==Behind the scenes==
When Blik flies the ''Ku'Amo'' off Caarimon and becomes involved in a dogfight, the opposing starfighter is flown by either the [[Filordus]] [[Yve (Filordus)|Yve]] or a member of the [[Heroes of Cularin]].
